newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai deputy finmin seeks central bank return.
newsitem.headline: Thai deputy finmin seeks central bank return.

text.p: Thai deputy finance minister Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi will seek his reinstatement as deputy governor of the Bank of Thailand after the November 17 general election, an aide said on Thursday.

The aide said the senior central bank official, who got his ministerial job in late September when outgoing Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa called snap elections, was concerned that political uncertaity after the poll may deprive him of a chance to return to the bank.
Chaiyawat intended to submit in his resignation on November 15, the last working day before the election weekend, the aide said.
Central bank sources said the 50-year-old economist was worried that a newly elected government may not recognise Banharn's promise to reappoint Chaiwat to his former job at the central bank.
